common_space_and_assumptions.source_model: Fixedgood Ji/Jf and definite nuclear parities with one allowed E/M type pi(L) per photon rank L. Same energy/normalized radial mode or angular-shell model and the full source emission isometry.
common_space_and_assumptions.initial_state: rho_i=I/(2Ji+1) for the isotropic scalar-block theorem. The retained state is the same full state projected onto retained ranks and renormalized; 0<=epsilon<1 and S_R>0.
common_space_and_assumptions.trace: Trace the complete FINAL NUCLEAR SPIN multiplet, not an unspecified additional recoil/source-position/environment or detector channel.
common_space_and_assumptions.photon_basis: Physical basis |L,m,q>, q=-1,+1. For each allowed type, chi_pi(q)=q^pi/sqrt2. The occupied copy |L,m,pi> uses that helicity vector; it is not an independent fictitious type flag.
common_space_and_assumptions.amplitude_convention: u_L is the common normalized emission coefficient (possibly conjugate to RB interaction coefficient), sum|u_L|^2=1. The source photon fraction is |u_L|^2, not a bare nuclear electric/magnetic RME squared.

isotropic_reduced_state_theorem.full_two_helicity_formula: rho_photon=directsum_L [w_L/(2L+1)] I_m^(L) tensor |chi_pi(L)><chi_pi(L)|. The unused opposite parity copy is zero. It is not w_L I_(2(2L+1))/(2L+1) or a fully mixed helicity-copy block.
isotropic_reduced_state_theorem.proof: The invariant input and covariant emission yield an invariant photon state after the final-spin partial trace. Different L irreps have no rotational intertwiner by Schur. A single occupied E/M copy perL leaves a scalar I_m block; trace V_L rho_i V_L_dagger=1 fixes1/(2L+1). ExactCG kernels independently verify the original A/B/C representations.
isotropic_reduced_state_theorem.phase_scope: All different-rank phases disappear in this isotropic reduced state, while weights/fractions remain. Equal weights give the same photon-only state even if phases differ; phase information may still reside in photon/final-spin correlations before tracing.

trace_distances_and_projector.isotropic_distance: For the full state and its renormalized retained projection, D_photon=epsilon. Retained blocks have total negative difference trace-epsilon and omitted blocks positive trace+epsilon.
trace_distances_and_projector.full_joint_distance: The old95 full emitted state INCLUDING final spin has exactD_full=sqrt(epsilon) for the same initialrho. Partial trace can reduce that distance; the two spaces must not be conflated.
trace_distances_and_projector.arbitrary_common_initial_density: For any PSD trace-one initialrho under the same emission model, P_O=sum_omitted ranksP_L is an abstract photon effect. V_dagger(P_O tensor I_final)V=epsilon I_initial, so full probabilityepsilon, retained probability0.
trace_distances_and_projector.general_bounds: The variational effect characterization and contractive final-spin trace give epsilon<=D_photon<=sqrt(epsilon), whenever the retained reference exists. Isotropic input attains the lower value; no all-case upper sharpness is asserted.
trace_distances_and_projector.not_phase_measurement: The rank projector probabilities only contain w_L and do not recover phase/sign. In the isotropic definite-parity theorem the whole photon-only state is already phase-blind.
trace_distances_and_projector.extra_channels: A further arbitrary CPTP/environment/detector channel can erase or mix ranks. It retains an upper distance contraction but need not preserve the epsilon lower bound or rank-projector probabilities without a corresponding effect/support audit.
trace_distances_and_projector.endpoints: epsilon0 gives identical states directly, without defining a zero omitted isometry. epsilon1/S_R0 has no normalized retained reference; S0 has no emitted state.

local_observable_vs_global_state.point_helicity_matrix: For any directionn, sum_m D_mq D_mqprime^*=delta_qqprime. Each scalar rank block gives local H_qqprime=delta_qqprime/2; sumw=1 givesW=1 and all normalized local Stokes components0.
local_observable_vs_global_state.measurement_class: Normalized direction-local linear/circular/unpolarized photon bins with the same bounded response therefore do not identify fractions in this isotropic case. This does not assert equal absolute photon widths, unnormalized yields, lifetime/ICC data or all experimental companions.
local_observable_vs_global_state.global_projector: The ideal whole angular-mode rank projector is a valid abstract photon POVM and can distinguish different fraction vectors. It is not a direction-local detector effect and no ordinary gamma detector implementation or new experimental companion is claimed.
local_observable_vs_global_state.quantum_state_boundary: Equal normalized local W/polarization distributions are not equality of the full formal photon density operator. Different w_L give different rank-block states, even when all local point data are the same.
local_observable_vs_global_state.existing_joint_and_U_pair_interpretation: The isotropic photon marginal removes cross-L phases, not necessarily the rotationally invariant photon-plus-final-spin joint copies. Existing tagged/cascade observables may access such correlations only under their declared source geometry/instrument conditions, without guaranteed global phase recovery or uniqueness. The old U pair has different fractions, so its formal photon marginals cannot be identical: Tr(P_L rho_photon)=w_L for any initialrho. No old global/cascade matrices are rerun.

parity_multiplicity_scope.required_one_copy: Definite initial/final parities select one E/M type perL. Schur fixes the identity on m, not on an arbitrary multiplicity space.
parity_multiplicity_scope.relaxed_general_form: If coherent E/M types of the same L are both allowed, rotational invariance only gives I_m/(2L+1) tensor C_L, with a positive multiplicity matrix C_L that can retain E/M coherence. This is not the scalar one-copy theorem.
parity_multiplicity_scope.existing25_27_boundary: Prior RB67-25 has an isotropic nondefinite-parity spin-half control with circular polarization, and RB67-27 retains f_q=(S+2q ReX)/(2S), X=sum a_E,L a_M,L^*. Isotropic initialspin alone doesnot forceReX0 orPc0.
parity_multiplicity_scope.rank_partition: The omitted effect above partitions ranks. If a relaxed problem omits one E/M type but retains another at the sameL, a rank-only projector is not that type projector; its probability need not be the omitted-type fraction.

kappa_and_reuse_boundaries.old329_space: The old2/5/7 point constants are compressed on the joint H_emit INCLUDING final spin. Do not replace its full distance with this smaller photon-only D while keeping the samekappa; photon support/effect compression needs its own audit.

kappa_and_reuse_boundaries.common_model: Keep the same retained amplitudes/initialrho, energy/radial mode, source origin and final-spin trace. Uncontrolled extra environment/recoil/source-position reductions or refits are outside the exact state identities.
kappa_and_reuse_boundaries.no_real_beam_tomography: No center-of-mass/recoil/translation/source-position/temporal response is modeled, and no actual in-beam photon-state tomography or global-rank analyzer is claimed. Additional averaging needs an output-mode/effect or projector-pullback audit; it can remove the epsilon lower bound.
kappa_and_reuse_boundaries.physical_scope: All original A/B/C amplitudes and new isotropic condition are ideal source-model parameters. No actual prior, coherent apparatus, quantum state preparation, measured fraction or real nucleus is certified.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Day8 L2 photon-rank state after isotropic emission/final-spin trace.

Only the existing A/B/C spins/mode sets/seeds are used. Default execution is
read-only; --write-receipt exclusively creates the one owned JSON. No producer
or test suite is executed and no parameter/angle grid is opened.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fractions import Fraction as Q
from functools import lru_cache
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path


RUN_REL = 'outputs/learning-daily/20261007-DAY8-angular-momentum-selection-rules-multipolarity-run-01'
CODE_REL = 'tmp/day8-20261007/runtime/isotropic-photon-rank-state/isotropic_photon_rank_state.py'
README_REL = 'tmp/day8-20261007/runtime/isotropic-photon-rank-state/README.md'
OUT_REL = RUN_REL + '/isotropic-photon-rank-state.json'
HELPER_REL = 'tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/truncation-observable-bound/independent-review/fraction_radiation_audit.py'
HELPER_SHA = 'c464bd0f553f906f0f134fda39621c33cc40919d4f8eeb986546b47d43e883da'
PRIORS = {
    'A': ('angular-degeneracy.json', '0b633e74a96925cbaced95073407523f441cd6ed89554c15f87b84758e89f334'),
    'B': ('four-multipole-observable-rank.json', '42b7c697dc6522fa384e0934fc545a0010a614ff2af3cfcbf767729242bf5f48'),
    'C': ('case-c-angular-polarization-rank.json', '15599129f0079603cf26b4d5a909bb3799b605c55bdc248d570502c164e77bb1'),
    'old95': ('truncation-observable-bound.json', '8d836c358937581ae05b9923c2f222938d56cce493c4cb5056299ed550f3cec9'),
    'old329': ('finite-rank-density-bound.json', '2636cac3929b3b28bb5b29badf5bc9df7e74d7d16378db42cb726d0bbdfe8538'),
    'parity25': ('nondefinite-parity-control.json', 'bc74eed5b62673fb8fb3b4ef2fb862cceb85870f36d36e58d8721027e1a620bb'),
}
RAW_REL = 'raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/multipolarity/mixing ratio/1967_Rose et al_Angular Distributions of Gamma Rays in Terms of Phase-Defined Reduced Matrix Elements.pdf'
RAW_SHA = '8f846b61b9320de291ee5600126c5e286a0fe05968df819696816f0dc1ec57dc'


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def projections(J):
    return [-J + i for i in range(int(2 * J + 1))]


def build_receipt(root):
    mathematical = {}

    def check(name, value):
        mathematical[name] = bool(value)
        if not mathematical[name]:
            raise RuntimeError('Exact state control failed: ' + name)

    tracked, prior, records = {}, {}, {}
    for name, (filename, expected) in PRIORS.items():
        path = root / RUN_REL / filename
        content = path.read_bytes()
        if digest(content) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError('Frozen prior identity changed: ' + name)
        tracked[path] = content
        prior[name] = json.loads(content)
        records[name] = {'path': RUN_REL + '/' + filename, 'sha256': expected}
    raw = (root / RAW_REL).read_bytes()
    if digest(raw) != RAW_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError('Raw identity changed')
    tracked[root / RAW_REL] = raw
    helper_path = root / HELPER_REL
    helper = helper_path.read_bytes()
    if digest(helper) != HELPER_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError('Independent Fraction helper identity changed')
    tracked[helper_path] = helper
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('isotropic_independent_fraction_helper', helper_path)
    h = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(h)

    @lru_cache(None)
    def cg(Jf, L, Ji, Mf, m, Mi):
        return h.cg(Jf, L, Ji, Mf, m, Mi)

    A_branch = prior['A']['root_demonstration']['branches'][1]
    weightsA = {1: Q(A_branch['E1_radiative_fraction']), 2: Q(A_branch['M2_radiative_fraction'])}
    fractionsB = prior['B']['seed']['radiative_fractions']
    weightsB = {L: Q(fractionsB[label]) for L, label in ((1, 'M1'), (2, 'E2'), (3, 'M3'), (4, 'E4'))}
    parametersC = prior['C']['seed']['parameters']
    u, v = Q(parametersC['u']), Q(parametersC['v'])
    S_C = 1 + u ** 2 + v ** 2
    weightsC = {2: 1 / S_C, 3: u ** 2 / S_C, 4: v ** 2 / S_C}
    cases = (
        ('A_3half_to_half', Q(3, 2), Q(1, 2), ((1, 0), (2, 1)), weightsA, (1,), Q(3, 4)),
        ('B_2_to_2', Q(2), Q(2), ((1, 1), (2, 0), (3, 1), (4, 0)), weightsB, (1, 2), Q(5, 41)),
        ('C_3_to_1', Q(3), Q(1), ((2, 0), (3, 1), (4, 0)), weightsC, (2,), Q(13, 49)),
    )
    results = {}
    for name, Ji, Jf, modes, weights, retained, expected_e in cases:
        Ni = int(2 * Ji + 1)
        initial, final = projections(Ji), projections(Jf)
        cg_norms = []
        for L, pi in modes:
            for Mi in initial:
                norm = h.sum_scalar(h.mul(h.conj(cg(Jf, L, Ji, Mf, Mi - Mf, Mi)), cg(Jf, L, Ji, Mf, Mi - Mf, Mi)) for Mf in final)
                cg_norms.append(norm == h.scalar(1))
        check(name + '_all_initial_CG_norms_one', all(cg_norms))
        kernel = []
        for L, pi in modes:
            for LP, pip in modes:
                for m in range(-min(L, LP), min(L, LP) + 1):
                    # With rho_initial=I/Ni, same final Mf and initial Mi force
                    # m=mprime. Other m/mprime entries vanish by CG selection.
                    value = h.sum_scalar(h.mul(cg(Jf, L, Ji, Mf, m, Mf + m), h.conj(cg(Jf, LP, Ji, Mf, m, Mf + m))) for Mf in final)
                    value = h.scale(value, Q(1, Ni))
                    expected = h.scalar(Q(1, 2 * L + 1) if L == LP else 0)
                    kernel.append({'L': L, 'Lprime': LP, 'm': m, 'partial_final_spin_kernel': str(value.get((1, 0), Q(0))) if not value or set(value) == {(1, 0)} else 'nonrational',
                                   'matches_delta_L_Lprime_over_2Lplus1': value == expected})
        check(name + '_isotropic_partial_trace_scalar_rank_blocks', all(item['matches_delta_L_Lprime_over_2Lplus1'] for item in kernel))
        check(name + '_cross_rank_phases_are_removed', all(item['partial_final_spin_kernel'] == '0' for item in kernel if item['L'] != item['Lprime']))
        check(name + '_normalized_full_weight_trace_one', sum(weights.values(), Q(0)) == 1 and all(value >= 0 for value in weights.values()))
        epsilon = sum((value for L, value in weights.items() if L not in retained), Q(0))
        check(name + '_existing_seed_omission_fraction_exact', epsilon == expected_e and epsilon < 1)
        ret_weights = {L: value / (1 - epsilon) for L, value in weights.items() if L in retained}
        check(name + '_retained_trace_one', sum(ret_weights.values(), Q(0)) == 1)
        trace_norm = sum((abs(value - ret_weights.get(L, Q(0))) for L, value in weights.items()), Q(0))
        D_photon = trace_norm / 2
        check(name + '_photon_trace_distance_equals_omitted_fraction', D_photon == epsilon)
        check(name + '_omitted_rank_projector_probability_full_epsilon_retained_zero', sum((weights[L] for L in weights if L not in retained), Q(0)) == epsilon and sum((ret_weights.get(L, Q(0)) for L in weights if L not in retained), Q(0)) == 0)
        check(name + '_epsilon_between_zero_and_square_root_upper', 0 <= epsilon and epsilon ** 2 <= epsilon)
        check(name + '_isotropic_local_helicity_half_half', sum(weights.values(), Q(0)) / 2 == Q(1, 2))
        results[name] = {
            'Ji': str(Ji), 'Jf': str(Jf), 'initial_density': 'I_' + str(Ni) + '/' + str(Ni),
            'modes': [{'L': L, 'pi': pi, 'label': ('E' if pi == 0 else 'M') + str(L)} for L, pi in modes],
            'retained_ranks': list(retained), 'weights': {str(L): str(value) for L, value in weights.items()},
            'retained_weights': {str(L): str(value) for L, value in ret_weights.items()},
            'occupied_parity_copy_photon_dimension': sum(2 * L + 1 for L, _ in modes),
            'source_joint_emitted_dimension': Ni * len(modes),
            'block_eigenvalue_and_multiplicity': [{'L': L, 'pi': pi, 'eigenvalue': str(weights[L] / (2 * L + 1)), 'multiplicity_m': 2 * L + 1} for L, pi in modes],
            'epsilon': str(epsilon), 'D_photon_exact': str(D_photon), 'full_joint_D_squared_exact': str(epsilon),
            'local_W': '1', 'local_helicity_density': 'I2/2', 'local_normalized_Stokes': {'Q': '0', 'U': '0', 'V_circular': '0'},
            'CG_norm_control_count': len(cg_norms), 'partial_trace_common_m_coefficients': kernel,
            'control_boundary': 'Only original source A/B/C spins and existing nontrivial amplitude weights, with the explicitly requested isotropic initial density. No new nucleus, phase seed, angle or detector model.',
        }
    chi0 = [[h.scale(h.radical(2), Q(1, 2))], [h.scale(h.radical(2), Q(1, 2))]]
    chi1 = [[h.scale(h.radical(2), Q(-1, 2))], [h.scale(h.radical(2), Q(1, 2))]]
    check('physical_helicity_parity_copies_are_normalized_and_orthogonal', h.mm(h.adjoint(chi0), chi0) == [[h.scalar(1)]] and h.mm(h.adjoint(chi1), chi1) == [[h.scalar(1)]] and h.mm(h.adjoint(chi0), chi1) == [[{}]])
    check('copy_projector_trace_one_not_helicity_identity_trace_two', h.trace(h.mm(chi0, h.adjoint(chi0))) == h.scalar(1) and h.trace(h.eye(2)) == h.scalar(2))
    for path, content in tracked.items():
        if path.read_bytes() != content:
            raise RuntimeError('Read-only input changed during arithmetic: ' + str(path))
    code = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    readme_path = root / README_REL
    readme = readme_path.read_bytes() if readme_path.exists() else None
